events.name: Race weekend
events.summary: Up to 125,000 spectators a day across the grandstands, general admission banks and gates.

events.name: Conference day
events.summary: The pit building, halls and amphitheatre host conventions and exhibitions all year.

locations.name: Blue Mountain Racing Circuit
locations.description: A compact 4.8 km concept circuit. The eastern technical section turns inward around the academy and automotive grounds; the long-straight return reaches into the infield. Published length, width and straight-length targets are retained. Illustrative, not a published masterplan.

locations.name: Pit Lane
locations.description: Infield pit lane, behind the continuous pit wall. A separate working apron fronts the west-facing garages.

locations.name: Pit / Conference Building
locations.description: West-facing garages open onto the infield pit apron. Conference floors have a separate public entrance at the south end, reached by the pedestrian bridge.

locations.name: Paddock
locations.description: Team compound directly behind the garages. Two rows of support units and equipment awnings flank loading courts, transverse lanes and a rear service spine.

locations.name: Grandstand A
locations.description: Covered grandstand at the southern end of the start-finish straight, looking across to the pit building. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand B
locations.description: Covered grandstand on the start-finish straight, opposite the pit garages and the start line. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand C
locations.description: Covered grandstand overlooking the heavy braking zone into Turn 1. Illustrative.

locations.name: Grandstand D
locations.description: Covered grandstand outside the hairpin at the end of the long straight. Illustrative.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 1
locations.description: Grass bank inside Turn 1 and Turn 2.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 2
locations.description: Grass viewing bank outside the tighter eastern technical section, behind its protective boundary.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 3
locations.description: Grass viewing bank beside the diagonal return towards the southern corners.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 4
locations.description: Grass bank looking north over Turns 10 and 11.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 5
locations.description: Grass bank inside Turns 12 and 13.

locations.name: General Admission Bank 6
locations.description: Grass bank on the outside of the final corner, looking up the start-finish straight.

locations.name: Gateway Arch

locations.name: Infield Park
locations.description: Planted grass buffers around the automotive demonstration grounds. Defined walks and a drainage strip retain open landscape between the working compounds and the circuit.

locations.name: Infield Road

locations.name: Pit working apron
locations.description: Working bays between the pit lane and garage doors, east of the pit wall.

locations.name: Paddock service aisles
locations.description: Continuous loading aisles and cross lanes connect the rear garage doors and team rows to the service spine.

locations.name: Team support rows
locations.description: Permanent team support units, covered equipment bays and open loading courts. Race weekend adds transporters in the covered bays.

locations.name: Conference pedestrian bridge
locations.description: Public bridge from the arrival concourse over the start-finish straight and pit lane. Ramped approaches connect to the south conference entrance and the hospitality walk without using paddock service aisles.

locations.name: Conference entrance walk
locations.description: Public concourse from the arrival plaza to the bridge, behind the main stands.

locations.name: Infield guest walk
locations.description: Guest route from the footbridge to the south conference entrance and hospitality courtyard. It remains south of the team compound and west of vehicle access.

locations.name: Conference entrance
locations.description: Public south lobby of the pit building, separate from team loading behind the garages.

locations.name: Infield hospitality courtyard
locations.description: Guest compound overlooking the southern return, with pavilions, shaded court and viewing terrace. Deliveries arrive at its north edge; guests approach from the west.

locations.name: Infield hospitality pavilions
locations.description: Three permanent pavilions opening onto the shaded courtyard and southern viewing terrace.

locations.name: Infield viewing terrace
locations.description: Open terrace looking south towards the return corners, behind the protective boundary.

locations.name: Hospitality courtyard paths
locations.description: Pedestrian courtyard, pavilion entrances and viewing terrace connected to the public guest walk.

locations.name: Hospitality shade court
locations.description: Raised shade canopy around the guest courtyard.

locations.name: Infield drainage swale
locations.description: Planted drainage and open grass buffer through the central infield.

locations.name: Academy handling ground
locations.description: A dedicated vehicle-control and slalom compound north of the skid pan. Its access spur threads between karting and the skid pan without crossing either track.

locations.name: Academy handling course
locations.description: A low-speed handling loop with a separate slalom lane and clear service access. Permanent markings explain the use of the northern infield.

locations.name: Academy briefing bays
locations.description: Covered preparation and briefing bays at the handling compound, served from its western access aisle.

locations.name: Automotive demonstration court
locations.description: A paved vehicle demonstration compound within the planted infield park. Connected to the automotive and academy service network, separate from the hospitality guest walks.

locations.name: Automotive demonstration loop
locations.description: A marked low-speed loop around vehicle display courts and preparation bays.

locations.name: Vehicle display courts
locations.description: Permanent light-paved demonstration bays inside the automotive loop, with clear circulation around them.

locations.name: Automotive preparation bays
locations.description: Three low support pavilions on the demonstration court, grouped along its north service edge.

locations.name: Demonstration bay markings
locations.description: Marked display bays inside the automotive demonstration loop.
